Usage: astryx doctor integration templates [options] [package]

Validate integration template replacements and Core id overlaps

Arguments:
  package     Installed integration package name; omit to check the package in the current directory.

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  replacement declarations are valid; undeclared id conflicts are warnings
  1  the integration, a template, or a replacement declaration is invalid

Examples:
  # Check the local integration
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 doctor integration templates
  # Check an installed integration
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 doctor integration templates @acme/widgets --json

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/doctor-integration-templates
